page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; one marginal note to the right, beside the line "Ejus summa haec". Running head at the top, page number 161 at the top right. Signature "M 5" and catchword "agrum" at the foot.

main_text.p: mannus & judices jusjurandum darent Reip. Verùm cùm ne his quidem conditionibus contenti possent esse agrarii, Albano Duce rerum potiente in Belgio, rursus ad eum querelas detulere: Ille causâ cognita anno M. D. LXXI, die VII Augusti decretum iterum interposuit, verbis varians à capitibus his, re penè idem. Ejus summa haec: Groninganis integrum sit jus stapulae & mercatum in butyro, caseo, pecore equino bovinoque, frumento omnis generis: quorum nihil liceat exportare, nisi Groningae venale habitum ab horâ matutinâ ad meridiem. Nulli peregrino liceat quicquam sive ἐπιχώριον[?] sive ἐπείσακτον in agro emere aut vendere: in urbe liceat: attamen liberum eidem sit ea, quae ipse advexerit, in ipsis portibus, aut prope eos è navigiis venundare, cui volet. Vitandae fraudis causâ, quae Groningae promercalia fuere, ea à praefecto ad id dato in indicem referantur, vasaque butyri notâ insignantur. In trutinâ urbanâ pondera sint uniformia: nec civis, nec agri incola negotiationibus deditus mensibus Majo, Junio, Julio, Augusto jumenta aliave quaestus faciendi causa pet

page.notes: The marginal note on the right reads "Decretum Ducis Albani." (set over two lines, "Decretum" / "Ducis Albani." with the hyphenated "Al-" / "bani."), beside the line "Ejus summa haec". The Greek words "ἐπιχώριον" and "ἐπείσακτον" are uncertain in their final letters; the first is marked [?]. The line ends on the partial word "pet" and continues on the next page, as printed. The digitiser's watermark at lower right is not transcribed.
